claims.text: The sentence reordering (SR) task is the most effective pre-training task, achieving the highest ROUGE-2 scores.
Among the three pre-training tasks, SR works slightly better than Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
Using all three tasks together generally outperforms using them individually, but SR consistently achieves the best results when more data is added.
